QuestInfo.name: Questionable Hatchtions
QuestInfo.0: Spiegelmann looks anxious. Check in with him.
QuestInfo.1: The egg appears to have a small crack in it. This is it!
QuestInfo.2: The egg hatched... a baby White Tiger?! What sort of abomination is this?!

0.0: Look, I'm offering you a once-in-a-lifetime experience for NEXT to nothing. You see that crack? Manon's Egg is about to hatch!

yes.0: Finally I'll have my own little servant of darkness to reign terror down on the... I mean, can you go check on the egg for me?

1.0: #b(The egg shakes as the crack widens. It's hatching!)#k

npc.0: That egg could pop open at any moment!
